name: Westweg (Östliche Variante)
description_md:
The Westweg (Östliche Variante) is a waymarked hiking route in Germany. It spans 92.7 km with 3028 m of ascent and 3625 m of descent.

This route takes about 32 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule and has an easy difficulty derived from distance and ascent. It is part of the national waymarked hiking network. The line matches the official route published by swisstopo. The route passes Basel within 1700 m and St. Jakob within 1900 m.
